in_marathi.name: Yuvika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yuvika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Yuvika means 'bringer of joy in youth'. It is a gentle, nurturing name that represents the growth and joy that comes with the passage of time.
